notes.title: What Are The Devs Up To Now?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/a9b9823f4ab2fe45024ff5c283d9daac51cd4054.jpg[/img]

Hey there!

It's us, your friendly neighborhood experimental indie game devs. It's a fact that while True: learn() is a game that is done by now, We're still happy to see new feedback from you, the players, years after the game was released! It's an honor and joy, and we are endlessly grateful to all of you!

We have some thoughts about future updates for the game (no dates or promises yet, though), but for now, we are exploring some new ideas, which we'd like to share with you!

[b](Scroll down for team's cat pictures)[/b]

[h3]Latest News[/h3]

As you may already know, we have released the v1.0 game of our next cat-themed game, Learning Factory, which PC Gamer once called '[i]an adorable factory game about machine learning and cats[/i]'. Adorable AND gigantic, we might add. A simple idea of a cat-themed tycoon led to almost 5 years in development and over 100 hours of content.

There's a demo if you haven't tried it yet:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

As for our other game, Craftomation 101, a spiritual successor of while True: learn(), in which you get to actually use visual programming on goofy robots, things are going fine for it. We have prepared a plan of things that we're planning to add before the 1.0 release (here's a [url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/looking-good-mates-craftomation-101]deep dive into it[/url]).

In the meantime, we were honored to be included in the 34th annual selection of pedagogically assessed games by the [url=https://www.bmfsfj.de/bmfsfj/service/publikationen/digitale-spiele-paedagogisch-beurteilt-band-34-255036]Federal Ministry for Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth of Germany[/url], which, to be honest, sounds very cool to us! Give it a read if you happen to be a German speaker:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/4df48b20dd9a91c2af205b1c5f0285a57c7dc356.png[/img]

And yes, there's a demo for Craftomation 101, if you want to give it a spin:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724140/Craftomation_101_Programming__Craft/

[h3]New Heights and Horizons[/h3]

Ivan the programmer now has some spare time (when he's not making updates for Learning Factory) to experiment with a new prototype. It's very, very early for any details, but it's safe to say that this project involves cats... and hexagonal tiles? Sure, why not:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/b4cdd932928730b6705f18da841149246ace42fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/4a73418ab83d1a27f58f061985e52674cfd6bbc5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/821df018d51d4ea7cfb762b03acf729f5b326842.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/3e2a625202e08fe07e6aac38846f90919006a936.png[/img]

Our lips are sealed for now, but stay tuned for more updates. To make sure you don't miss anything, do [url=https://ludenio.substack.com]subscribe to our newsletter[/url]!

Remember how we called ourselves 'experimental game dev studio'? We sure love experimenting, and we have recently assembled another brave internal team to try something completely different. Some teammates have joined us - a game designer, an artist, and even an animator. And they're experimenting like it's going out of style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/0429ec8c357b0e4f2b7d9f662fef5151019c9c51.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/7d53c864da500be7515ff350db581863d03e31f5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/eac1a5d76ebe2d268aa374c61fbb922e76dc7e68.png[/img]

Once again, we're deep in the pre-production stage right now; more gameplay types and art styles will be tested before - and if - we decide to move on.

But we will pick a direction eventually, so which one do you like more, 1, 2, or 3? Drop your thoughts in the comments or talk to us directly on our [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord server[/url]!

It makes even more sense because Discord server members will be the first to try out our next stage prototypes. Don't be a stranger!

We'll be in touch! But before we part ways for today, take a moment to gaze upon our studio's cats. As you can see, they are very well fed and taken good care of:

notes.title: A Catch-Up News Post - How Have You Been?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/6805cac4ca0f2900eb5b557210933b44c7f0ac55.png[/img]

Hey friends!

It appears that a few months have passed without any news from us, so we decided to write this post and share some updates.

First, [b]while True: learn() has reached a formidable number of 6000 reviews on Steam[/b]! We're infinitely grateful to you, the players, for your love and attention: could we ever dream that a niche puzzle game like ours could get this big? Well, we certainly did dream about that, but we did not really expect it to happen, and yet here we are. Thank you!

Although the active part of development is now over, we are still supporting the game: the plan for the next update is to improve localizations to all the available languages. Stay tuned for the news!

Second, as you may remember, we launched the spiritual successor of [b]while True: learn()[/b] named Craftomation 101. It uses similar node-based gameplay, but this time the programming part is very real: you'll get to write programs for a gang of goofy robots that will be helping you terraform a frozen planet:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724140/Craftomation_101/

If you like while True: learn(), we suggest you add Craftomation 101 to your wishlist as well, because, you know, [i]a certain Steam Sale is coming in a couple of weeks[/i], wink-wink, nudge-nudge! And in the meantime, you can check out the demo and decide whether this game is your cup of tea! Last but not least: the game was [url=https://latam.gamescom.global/en/big-festival-en/#finalists]selected as finalist at Gamescom Latam[/url], so keep your fingers crossed for us on Jun 26-30:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/f249ddb65adf53e84d087de7a594f8c9300e2ead.png[/img]

On a related matter, Craftomation 101 is made using Defold Engine, which we love very much, because it allows us to create a web-based versions of games in a very easy way - we'd like our games to be playable at schools, which are mostly equipped with Chromebooks these days.

And Defold engine runs on Lua programming language - which turned out to be a very peculiar experience for us! In fact, we wrote a whole article about writing a game on Lua, which made a splash on Reddit and The Hacker News. Check it out if you're into programming (lots of juicy details on coding with Lua inside):

[h3][url=https://blog.luden.io/what-do-i-think-about-lua-after-shipping-a-project-with-60-000-lines-of-code-bf72a1328733]What do I think about Lua after shipping a project with 60,000 lines of code? (15 minute read)[/url][/h3]

What else is new? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/][b]Learning Factory[/b][/url] is getting closer to release scheduled for this year, and if you'd like to keep track on our progress, [url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/the-great-beauty-of-mars-learning]subscribe to our blog[/url], in which we share news about our games every month!

And if you feel like saying hi to us personally, we're always up for a chat on our [url=https://ludenio.substack.com/p/the-great-beauty-of-mars-learning]Discord server[/url] (and in the comments, and in the email inbox, and almost everywhere, really).

Thanks for being with us through all these years! We'll be back with more exciting news :)

notes.title: Major Update v1.7.101: Controller Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/6ac23d07c9f67e0933779eef9b130b92dc2880ae.jpg[/img]
You know how it happens: first, you want to fix a thing or two in an old game. Next, you find yourself adding a bunch of features that you always wanted to add, because reasons. That's exactly what happened two us: 2 major updates in a row within a month, is that too much? Dr. Katz says 'NO!' 

So, here goes:

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
That's right, it's a thing now! Of course, while True: learn() was designed for good ol' mouse & keyboard, and that's a preferred means of control for most of our team members.

But maybe you're that type of player, who likes to play on PC but prefers devices tailored for gaming instead of those clickety-clackety office tools? Well, we got you!

Plug in your trusted gamepad, and go solve some puzzles! 

Controller support includes full compatibility with XBOX controllers, and all other XInput controllers and PlayStation controllers. Other brands may (and most likely will) work, but that is not guaranteed.

Additionally, controller scheme includes a very cute paw-shaped cursor! And if you find out that it's just not your cup of tea, just put the gamepad aside and return to the traditional means of control seamlessly!

Here's a couple of examples of the new interfaces (can you spot button tooltips?):

[h3]XBOX[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/f5d3acdd430f9c3db426efc45cbbbad0c66a0935.png[/img]

[h3]PlayStation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/ce6c0f3c84103f174604a416b12b123853aa9b0b.png[/img]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/d789b4caf784a9ea1dcb9bb722c2dff9b58304da.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus: Virtual keyboard[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/98be7ad19e0172aec3dc8bf50168569dd9641f2f.png[/img]

Other changes this update brings you include:
[list]
[*] Added an option to turn on a visual keyboard (English only)
[*] Links to educational materials updated
[*] Texts update
[*] Bug fixes
[*] UI/UX fixes
[*] Performance optimization
[/list]

We hope you find this new means of controlling your schemes useful! Please share your impressions in the comments or on our very friendly [url=https://discord.gg/ludenio]Discord[/url] server.

Until we meet again!

notes.title: Back To School: 25% Off while True: learn() / Free Learning Factory EDU
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/c9980d12e44d2c6e9122116e925bdc70c899854d.png[/img]
It's always kinda sad when summer comes to an end... But that also means that it's time to go back to school!

No matter what form of education you prefer: be it distance learning or good old fashioned classroom think tank -- we always salute your wish to learn something new! We even have a special deal for you (or maybe your significant others) who feels that curiosity itch:

[h3]while True: learn() is 25% off until September 6, 10am PST[/h3]

But learning means always moving towards new horizons. Throughout this summer (and good part of spring) we were looking out for new exciting ways for video games to empower and change modern education for the better.

We have been collaborating with teachers, we've been meeting with ed-tech experts, hey, we've even launched a YouTube show, in which we discuss the future of education with tech-savvy teachers who care.

[previewyoutube=6AzYQxBvdmU;full][/previewyoutube]

Like in this episode, we're meeting with Paul Darvasi, an educator with 20+ years of experience, who's now doing a visionnaire job, turning mainstream and indie [url=http://www.ludiclearning.org/]games into school lessons[/url]. 

And most importantly, we're joined by his 11-years old son Max, with an honest perspective on what is wrong with many of today's "educational games" and how games can and will be transforming classrooms.

With help from all kinds of awesome people from the world of education, we were developing our own attempt to adapt game mechanics to fit into classrooms. 

We're talking about [b]Learning Factory EDU[/b], which is meant to improve problem solving skills and introduce engineering practices to middle school children. It comes with teacher guides, and you can [url=https://luden.io/lfedu/]get it on our website. Oh, and it's free for everyone to use![/url]

[url=https://luden.io/lfedu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/4039ea0a423e5e06610a3da008abeb3d6267b55f.png[/img][/url]

Please share a link to Learning Factory EDU to anyone interested in applying video games in education, as we're looking for teachers and parents, willing to play it along with their learners and share feedback. This will help us turn LF EDU into a razor-sharp tool carving a way towards new knowledge!

Happy new school year!

Tell us about what you've learnt this summer?

notes.title: Happy Programmer's Day!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/6972dbbe77fb644606418dce7bd49e9ba169725d.png[/img]

September 13th is a very special occasion for us: it is also known as World Programmer's Day! Although while True: learn() is not a programming simulator per se, machine learning would not be possible without coding! 

It might seem a little bit weird, but on this year's Programmer's Day we'd like to talk to you about a coding-free game about coding. In our next big project, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/]Learning Factory[/url][/b], a player embarks on a journey to build a huge factory which is all about understanding cats using the means of machine learning. 

This time it's for real! Where [b]while True: learn()[/b] was mostly simulating a lifestyle of a data scientist, [b]Learning Factory[/b] is all about real machine learning: it is using [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_regression]linear regression[/url] for calculating optimal price of goods in a store, catering to need of some very picky cats! 

[i]"Machine learning helps to take all the factors into consideration. But before that would become possible, a player would have to prepare raw data for the algorithm. Actually, this is what 95% of working with machine learning in production is all about. In Learning Factory, we are trying to make this process as graphic and illustrative as possible -- hence the factory building concept. Different kinds of buildings would collect different kinds of data, which then flows to data cluster cores where the mathematical magic is happening. Say, a player wants to build a model which would acknowledge the price of goods, the type of store and something less obvious, like, cats' ears shape. They would have to streamline the data to a cluster core, push a button and let the algorithm calculate the optimum price within the dataset"[/i] -- [b]Ivan Kapranov, lead coder at Luden.io[/b]

You can read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1150090/announcements/detail/4582931987115338682]full story in this post[/url]. And if you're interested in learning more about machine learning (and/or building automated factories for cats!), it's easy as pie! Here's your short list of options:

1. Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/W8KhjSf]Discord Server[/url] to play Learning Factory's Alpha
2. Subscribe to our [url=https://nivalvr.us11.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=524b2f0bfc899ad323e62bcf3&id=3d62d2eebd]E-mail list[/url] (which will also allow you to play the Alpha!)
3. Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/][b]Learning Factory[/b][/url] to your wishlist: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/378569e179e35299fb9734afd991d42f86972036.gif[/img]

Don't be a stranger! Let us know what you think about our next game and don't hesitate to join our ranks of cat-loving engineers! And in any case: HAPPY PROGRAMMER'S DAY, EVERYONE! The future is digital!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/4282ee8ea178ac8d19810704be4126d6e70c1dce.jpg[/img]

Wow, what a spring, huh?

We know that learning new stuff is something that we could do, but few of us were really up to doing. Quarantine was in effect, stress levels were skyrocketing and couch seemed like the place to be.

That said, we were very surprised with how many of you were still playing an educational puzzle game about machine learning! We love you fellas, we really do!

Although we were busy with releasing the game on Nintendo Switch, we could never forget about you PC geeks out there! Now, we're saving some new content for the future, but today we are releasing a very cool update. Here's what it brings:

[list]
[*] A lot of code optimization, like, A LOT. Especially when using custom nodes. The game should run way smoother than before!
[*] That also means the game now loads and switches between screens a lot faster
[*] Many minor bugs were eliminated and should never bug you again
[*] For the fans of "ESC" button we have a treat: it's now doing it's escaping stuff on more screens than ever before
[*] For fans of buttons in general: we've added a "Select all" button as an alternative to CTRL+A or dragging your mouse around
[*] Tutorials were also improved
[*] The following community translations were updated: Dutch (by Bwremjoe), Danish (by legenden), Japanese (by yasuoo), Italian (by Harkeidos), Turkish (by Kadir). Thank you fellas for your hard work, you're breathtaking!
[*] Added new community translation: Vietnamese (by GleeOM). You're breathtaking as well!
[*] Official localisations were updated as well. That includes English, Russian and Chinese version. That makes us also somewhat breathtaking (but not like you guys)
[/list]

Is that it? Well, it is... for today! Stay tuned for more updates and exciting news! And, most importantly, stay safe!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/7b6af01c598fa66eb98175a954113cd6c905ffd2.png[/img]

Hey there! 

It's been a while. The whole world seems to have changed since last time we've spoken. So first and foremost, we hope that you're healthy and safe!

As for us, there have been big things moving around, but not much to tell. Well, until today!

FIrst, we're almost through the process of releasing while True: learn() on Nintendo Switch! It's really around the corner and most likely by the time it's safe to go out again you'll be able to take your favorite machine learning puzzle along with you!

We're also seriously working on the PS4 and Android versions of the game, looking to entirely disrupt the barriers between you and learning about machine learning!

Speaking about that: if you happen to represent a school/university/other educational institution on quarantine, [b]we're willing to give you while True: learn() for free[/b]! Guess what, we will give you any of our games for you to help your students keep up the learning spirit while the doors are closed! All you have to do is email our friendly CEO Oleg at [url=mailto:oleg.chumakov@luden.io]oleg.chumakov@luden.io[/url]

Maybe give a hint to a teacher you know? We have a VR games about neural anatomy and fighting viruses (oh, the irony!), along with a VR game for autistic children and bunch of other stuff! Check out the blogpost below!

Anyway, despite the turbulent news agenda, we wish you to find that inner strength to cheer up and do things that really matter -- including playing video games and definitely learning something new!

Let's be together! Let us know what's up with you in the comments? We'll be in touch

notes.title: One Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/89a73085e46765b441d1728dd405736ad35c6a2b.png[/img]
Hi all,

What a day! One year ago this tiny-crazy-cat-based educational video game was released. It was a really fun year! We'll never forget this journey from 86% to 92% review score. And we won a prize! This prize is a huge and super friendly, sharp and just amazing community. 

Thank you, everyone, who played the game, watched the game on YouTube, downloaded the game from torrents (please ask your favorite pirates to update the game to the latest version, we can't stand seeing people struggling with already fixed issues). Thank you to all the amazing teachers, parents, and educators who use the game, you are really rockstars, inventors, innovators and main inspirers on the planet. And of course congratulations and our kudos to all of the learners who managed to get hired or just dived deeper into machine learning technology. All the cats here (I know there are a number of them here) are also always welcome, we'll never tell your secret to anyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/9b16f0b27fd2be969c042fc1ff67f227bf9004de.jpg[/img]
[i](if you want to learn more about those certificates please feel free to email me at oleg.chumakov@luden.io)[/i]

You are probably wondering what we are up to those days. Okay, since you asked I am happy to tell more. 

First of all, we're at the final stage of the Nintendo Switch version of the game. We want to make a closed test for our friends' club (you are definitely in) but it's technically impossible on the Nintendo Platform. If we'll find a way - you will be the first to know about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/2606ad19a3c33983930ac579c407ca378153d887.png[/img]

Secondly, we're developing while True: learn() EDU to meet educators' needs. Of course, this version will be available for regular players as well.

Also, we're discussing how to make the next educational video game much better. Ideas, tests, and researches. At this very moment the only thing I can say that everyone who is in love with machine learning, startups part of while True: learn() and games like Rimworld and Factorio will get the vibe easily :)

A number of folks from Luden.io are now working with educators who work with kids with autism spectrum disorder. Video games are quite helpful for them as well, that's why we've started [url=https://rewire.education?utm_source=wtl_steam_post_footer]Rewire.Education[/url]  project. Actually, during playtests kids enjoyed while True: learn(), InMind and AIDraw games as well. 

[url=https://rewire.education?utm_source=wtl_steam_post_footer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/ebe4ec7f1e33dc895cdf04401b4f18a7a07ac4ed.png[/img][/url]

There are a lot of things happening every day in this direction (we've got back from a center for kids with autism an hour ago), but the only thing that matters here is that video games definitely could be really useful for education and help spark curiosity. Oh wait, is this the dream we started Luden.io with? That's totally correct! :) Thanks for making this dream come true, [b]you are the one who makes it real[/b]!

Your friends from the team of Luden.io with ❤️

The National Day of the People's Republic of China is coming and we couldn't be more excited! 

We know that there are many fans of while True: learn() in China, which is why we've spent the past few months polishing the Chinese translation of our game, to make it more precise and authentic. And now you can spend some of that holiday time to play and check if we've nailed the job!

Enjoy the new translation, enjoy the holidays, enjoy learning new stuff about machine learning and don't hesitate to let us know if you find any bugs or other things that can be improved. Hooray!

国庆节快乐！

我们知道国内有很多while True: learn()的玩家，这也是为什么我们花了好几个月的时间来改进游戏的中文，使它变得更加准确和真实。而现在，是时候利用国庆长假来检验我们的成果了！

来一起享受新的翻译，享受假期，享受学习新知识，如果你发现任何错误或其他可以改进的东西，请毫不犹豫地告诉我们。万岁!

Good ol’ Garfield the cat is famous for hating Mondays. Well, this Monday is different from all other Mondays and our cat is beaming with excitement today!

For the next week (that’s until 10 AM 09/23) [b]while True: learn() is 20% cheaper[/b]! After all, it’s September, best time in the year to start learning something new!

Start wrapping your head around machine learning, improve your problem-solving skills and buy that adorable cat a fancy new outfit! The little fella deserves it (as all cats do)

Speaking of outfits, just a friendly reminder: besides those cat costumes that you can buy from in-game shop, there’s a bunch of not-so-secret outfits you can unlock by using one of dozens of promo codes

Start with pressing ‘Esc’ button from your in-game room, you’ll find a field to enter the code there. And then try entering one of those magical words, hit ‘Enter’ and see what happens:

notes.title: Newsflash!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31382118/6d6402cae038717ee85018299c0ce9e4d7fe5c0f.png[/img]

Oh hi!

Having a nice September out there? Back to school, finally? Even if your school days are long over, it's never too late for quality learning!

Speaking of which! We have presented iOS version of [b]while True: learn()[/b] a couple of weeks ago, and now it's time to move on. Some of our team members are taking that long deserved vacation in September, but we'll still be thinking about what's next for our furry protagonist (and his cat).

Nintendo Switch maybe? Android version (obviously)? Or even that specially tailored educational edition of the game, that would feature some hardcore coding? We've been thinking of this idea for many months and now we finally have time to really explore the possibility.

Stay tuned! Keep throwing your feedback towards the comments section and our Discord server!

In the meantime, check out our cool photos from PAX West! We've been so glad to meet some of you there and our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1026800/while_True_learn_Mega_Map_of_Machine_Learning/]Mega Map of Machine Learning[/url] had made quite a splash!

notes.notes:
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/while-true-learn/id1443569124][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/a9793cba90ea8fba108b0b2fe97fc08cebe21f16.png[/img][/url]

Long story short, [url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/while-true-learn/id1443569124]here is the link[/url]. The game will become available on August 22 or August 29, depends on our current crunch focused on usability. We decided to make one more (oh boy, here we go again) iteration because we want to make the game extremely player-friendly: for all kinds of players, their kids, and students.

We hope you will enjoy the iOS version. But please be mindful of playtime. As our playtests have shown, game sessions on iPads & iPhones are much longer than on other devices. Do not forget to feed your cat if you have one!

Unfortunately, we have to choose the price from a bunch of presets in the AppStore. We are unable to set regional prices manually. After long research, we decided to choose the mildest price preset with the reduced price for educational institutions. For some regions, it will be cheaper than the PC version, and for others - a bit more expensive.

By the way, Release the cat is in the middle of an interview for a junior machine learning programmer position right now, thanks to the iOS version of the game. Oh, wait, no, Release is sleeping now. Maybe next time... what a classic cat.

notes.title: New Update: 1.1.72
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/682332508c9a41c8e21b9ccf324afa953901922b.jpg[/img]

How's summer going for you? Back in Moscow, we're almost freezing, and no, that's not because we're in Russia. We're just going through a chilly one.

We even had to make a special in-game item because of that, but we'll speak of it a bit further.

As for our new update, it's hot, hot, [b]HOT[/b]. Perhaps. it's the biggest one this summer! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] We've made the graphics more flexible, meaning that it now supports all kinds of display aspect ratio, not just 16:9. It even fits nicely on ultrawide displays. Or at least it's supposed to (let us know if it doesn't)!
[*] You've asked for it more than once and now it's here: self-driving car levels have been reworked! The tutorial was made way more comprehensive;
[*] Gameplay in the aforementioned levels has been smoothened and now is far less confusing
[*] We've also changed some minor interface elements in those same levels
[*] And we've added a warm and fuzzy blanket to your collective chair, in case your summer is as chilly as ours (or maybe you even live live in the Southern hemisphere and it's winter for you anyway)
[*] We've added some new backgrounds for your obscure in-game workplace. Should be more cozy now, goes well with the blanket, too!
[*] We've fixed some teeny-tiny bugs here and there
[/list]

Now, for the really important stuff! Our very own petting zoo is growing in all kinds of senses! Release the cat now looks prouder than ever:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/0dff431a6d477d90d4c8622296541bb293c6d9a3.jpg[/img]

And the new sheriff is in town! He's at the CEO's desk and the plate says 'Big Boss'. Fits him nicely:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/4913b9d3c583763c124fddeb7920939c719ebe55.jpg[/img]

He's actually a degu and his name is Vadim. He's reported to be capable of destroying cages, opening doors and suddenly jumping on you from various kinds of surfaces while you're asleep. And he's a biter. Look how mighty he is (pictured on the right):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/edbd0ce483166e1da8a4e02350a93ad25c8ea233.jpg[/img]

Anyway, the devs are back in the office and back to making this game even more awesome for you! Until next time then! Don't forget to share what you think about the new update in the comments and/or on our Discord server! 

Hell, go to town: mention us on Twitter, comment on Facebook, write us a paper letter, send us a raven (or maybe a degu). We'll be there for you!

notes.title: Major Update: 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/907840debcf57f8e569125b91cd8947cbada5a7d.png[/img]

Drumroll, please, update 1.1 is here!

Cat just got real!

First of all, we wanted to thank each and everyone who has bought the game and spared some time to leave us feedback. Your positive reviews make us shine on the inside and let us know that we’re doing something right.

Your negative reviews are even more valuable, because they let us grow and learn from our mistakes.

Namely, many of you have been pointing out a significant flaw with our custom/DLL nodes. They worked like magic, and not in a good sense, making the game inexplicably easier. It was not obvious how they work, too.

Well, obviously, we didn’t think this through. This part of the game was an artifact from Early Access, it was implemented by request from our hardcore players who didn’t see that side effect as a problem and neither did we.

But if it was breaking the experience for our players, it had to be fixed. We’re sorry that it took us so long, the task was way more difficult to tackle than we’d initially presumed.

And now they’re finally here! [b]New custom nodes[/b], transparent and shiny! Now you can visually see how neural network magic works inside them. They don’t make your schemes work faster unexpectedly anymore! Check them out:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/55bcce05b226802b859b8a5b750d08cb6b2657dd.gif[/img]

Think that’s it? Well, no! Here’s a brief list of changes introduced by this glorious update:

[b]- Custom/DLL nodes 2.0 (so cool we wanted to mention them again)
- Multiple quests redesigned, 2 quests done from scratch
- Oodles of UI tweaks all around the game
- Turkish localization: 98% complete
- Bugs fixed
- Performance optimized
- Main screen redesigned a little bit
- New and cool theme for the main menu: use the promo code MEME to unlock it[/b]

[b]Important notice:[/b] due to significant changes in the mechanics some of your older schemes might not be working anymore. A perfect chance to give them another go and nail them even better!

Let us know what you think! Does the game feel different now? What else would you like to see there? Let’s talk!

[b]BONUS: [/b] Up for some meme drawing? Here's that fancy 2-cats-1-programmer image without wording: https://imgur.com/Ek1UBKS Meme us! Works good as a wallpaper, too

notes.title: ML. In Simple Words.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/ad397f66e3c987f657e913d6cf21559bd4c54044.png[/img]

[i]Please find a promocode for this Dog + Cat skin below.[/i]

Hi everyone,

We have some exciting news for you today. A cool lad out there named vas3k once wrote a great article [b]"Machine Learning for Everyone. In simple words. With real-world examples. Yes, again"[/b]. And now its translation to English is finally available! The article is very funny and is perfect for helping others to understand what machine learning is and how it works. Even our artist Sergey read it! 

Here is the link to the article: https://vas3k.com/blog/machine_learning/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/c4c07163ef3c17ad17f0200a79fd474dc7c6a638.jpg[/img]

Speaking of the next while True: learn() update, we are continuing to go through your feedback. We are definitely planning to fix the issue with DLL and Custom Nodes, it is a very stupid issue and something we should have worked out long ago. It is a consequence of one of the concepts that appeared in the first months of development when we’ve been thinking that it is a great idea to tell about modularity in the game. Meaning that we can imagine that these blocks contain code that is rewritten in C++ and therefore works very quickly. But in the end, in puzzle mechanics, it looks weird.

We are working on bringing the game to iOS and Android, and at the same time, our heads are filled with thoughts about what the game’s future holds. We want to fix everything that raises questions so that the game brings joy to anyone who plays it. We are discussing such thoughts as adding real visual (or maybe not even visual) programming or separate storyline about real Machine Learning framework, such as, for example, TensorFlow. We also have some crazy ideas like making an additional browser game for Jupyter Notebook and a stand-alone game about managing programmable startups. 

What we want to say is that we are constantly trying to think what can our game turn into in the upcoming years and what our players want to do with it: simply have fun, build projects inside the game or prepare for machine learning interviews :) If you have not yet told us what you think about all this stuff, it is the right time to finally do so.

P.S. We have something amazing in progress, can't wait to tell you more. Here is a spoiler :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/61269cc53293f42773a6518551e4978f236b6a26.png[/img]

Thank you, we will be back soon.

notes.title: New Update, Next Steps
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/a77b8553f5fefea9be9c4e5d03347605e481aad3.jpg[/img]

Hey! It's us. How have you been?

We've been... Busy! And overwhelmed. With your love. With your support. With your critics (of course!). Even with your bug reports!

The only thing we didn't have time for is celebrating. Quite the contrary: we're ready to start taking next steps! For the past few days we were fixing the nastiest bugs (fortunately, they were not overwhelming) and answering your feedbacks. Here's what is expecting you in today's update:

[list]
[*] Startups rebalanced and optimized, along with some story levels
[*] Custom nodes & DLLs have been restricted to use for getting gold medal on certain levels 
[*] Updated randomization algorithms: remember when changing sockets in a block sometimes given you different results somehow? Not anymore!
[*] Updated translations: Chinese Simplified (99% done), French (99% done), Spanish (99% done), Turkish (12% done) and Dutch (12% done)
[*] More interactive objects in the character's room
[*] Many minor bugs and UI fixes
[*] We've added a comprehensive section to the game, which contains educational materials mentioned in the game, comfortably stacked in one place. You can also check this materials in our [url=https://blog.luden.io/learn-more-about-machine-learning-af496865ae6]blog entry[/url]
[*] Custom themes for the main menu (try BACKTOWTL promo code to check out for yourself). Oh and don't forget to try SPEEDPLAY promo code to get a very special cat skin, inspired by a certain [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/619150/announcements/detail/3341009127806116028]discussion[/url] on our forums
[/list]

While you're trying to process these small but numerous changes, we'll keep on working: our main task for this week will be to process your feedbacks from all the channels and decide what should we start doing next. Stay tuned ;)

notes.title: Major Update 0.4 + Helloween!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/b33c1214638d88e56ac8acd258d40d83b1b97be8.png[/img]

Are you thrilled? Well, we certainly are! But it’s not just the thrill of the upcoming Halloween, it’s the thrill of finally releasing that literally game changing update!

Ok, bear with us:

[list]
[*] Story mode! Oh yeah. Not anymore while True: learn() is just a game about machine learning, it’s about machine learning with meaning! Embrace the role of a brave coder on his way to finding common tongue with his very intelligent cat! Through science, obviously
[*] We mean, stuff just got real: there are comics, multiple endings, dialogues and whatnot. 
[*] It’s really more than just telling a story: we’ve reworked the whole level progression design. The game now looks 146% more like a real coder’s life. You even get to look stuff up on the Internet! 
[*] Halloween decorations, tricks, treats and all that!
[*] Bugs being fixed, code being optimized, UI being tweaked and lots of minor improvements which will make the gameplay so much enjoyable (or so we hope)
[/list]
Warning: the game has changed a lot, so brace yourselves before diving in! As always, bear in mind that we’re still in Early Access, so we’re going to polish and improve everything we’re introducing with this update in the future. That said, feel free to share your thoughts about this update in the comments, or our Discord server! 

Have a great weekend and see you soon!

notes.title: What is the Task Tree? And how it will work.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/05b5153fe9d6544e40fd46931b8e0631629b5ad7.png[/img]
[h1]Task Tree[/h1]
Today we would like to tell you why we decided to make a Task Tree.

Many players wrote to us that they wish to see more tasks dedicated to machine learning and less - dedicated to simple logic schemes. Some people even spoke that there is not enough machine learning in the game at all. To be honest with you, we added a lot of simple tasks to the game so that people who are not familiar with the programming topic would not get stuck in the beginning and got to learn the basics. Hey, we are not making excuses, you were absolutely correct: we did not separate EDUCATIONAL tasks from SIDE tasks. Well, we are glad to fix this.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/4bf5b442feb0e57156e213c8b1f87c5e985498ad.png[/img]

With the release of the Task Tree, everything in the game will get separated in 2 categories - main and side tasks. Main tasks will be located on the trunk of the Tree and they will be unlocking new sections of machine learning to you. Side quests will be put onto the branches of the Tree. They are needed to open rare items, earn money and simply train your skills in already opened nodes. 

[h1]As a result, there will be 2 paths every player will be able to follow:[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can rapidly beat only the tutorial tasks to see all the tasks from the machine learning section :(
[*]Complete the tutorial and side-quests in order to train your intelligence and earn money for all sorts of kitty costumes.
[/list]

And this is still not the end. It is so great that people wish to see more information about machine learning in the game! We’ve already added tutorial tips to each of the nodes (you need to press “i” in the list of nodes, it is located over the node to the right). 
Tutorials will tell you about how each node works in the game and how it works in real life (you will be able to see links to different articles on the internet or Youtube videos, which will tell you more details about the topic under the short description). We would also like to point out that we are planning to improve these tutorials, so they are far from their final state at the moment. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/ac5c1b91c78d48aa3d417a3618bc696a483304bf.png[/img]

[h1]Hi, everyone! 大家好 ![/h1]
This small unscheduled post is dedicated to our community from China, those, who speak Chinese and those, who simply doesn’t mind helping us out. :)

As you may know, we dream of making our game, while True: learn(), understandable for everyone in the world so that more people could play it with comfort. You are helping us greatly by adding new languages and translations to our special table:

[h1]This is why we are looking for people who will help us translate the game to the Chinese language.[/h1]

Today we will add a new room to our Discord channel for those, who are ready to help us with Chinese translation. And, of course, let’s not forget about the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Zc0fmbfYUZL2FtEwB0Fj0efEylCP8xfoyvJW8V1jvSU/edit?ts=5abe204a#gid=0]translation table.[/url]

Hi everyone! We are very happy that you are enjoying while True: learn() and are actively participating in the game development, so, in return, we would love to tell you about the plans we have on the upcoming update, which will be released on this Friday.

[h1]Saves[/h1]

[h1]Today we have already added changes to the game:[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can copy settings in Random forest
[*]Now estimated cost does not change
[*]The save slots are now 20, not 4, as it was before
[*]You can read the tutorial at any time
[/list]

In our plans for the week - to understand what our community wanted to see in the game. And add it to the game as quickly as possible! By the way, our team has a new programmer, so from now we will do everything much faster.

notes.title: Why are we here? [Get free access to Pre Alpha]
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31382118/3a0c2a9d1f022e658facf843286da32d76785445.jpg[/img]

Wow, a real human being on this page! That was unexpected. Thank you for coming here, please read the text until the very end and you will get lucky today!

Let's be honest, we are nervous a little bit (Do you feel nervous sometimes? We surely do now). We are entering Steam so early because we want to know if the machine learning and programming topic is interesting to players. Of course, we are sure that everyone will be cray-cray about our super-genial concept and everyone is interested in getting an answer to the question: "What is machine learning? How can I code one? Where can I learn about that without boring lectures while having fun?". But is that really so?

Therefore, since you are here, on this page, and have even read until this point, - it means that we are on the right way. Help us stop stressing out and write us a few words (e.g. "good game") in the comment section that you were here and what do you think about our idea. 

As a reward for your time, kindness, generosity and wisdom we would love to grant you access to the closed club of superhumans who have a possibility to play the pre-release version of the game.

Here is the link: http://eepurl.com/c8mpOP (you'll need to enter your email).

Thank you kindly, we are making all of this thanks to people like you :)
